cases.name: all-kinds-valid
cases.why: The four kinds, choices, other and agent are admitted in document order.

cases.name: text-is-normalized
cases.why: Titles and choices are trimmed and every whitespace run, including a decoded NBSP, becomes one space.

cases.name: at-the-limits-is-valid
cases.why: A 200-point title, 20 choices of 200 points and a 64-point agent are the largest admitted sizes.

cases.name: code-points-not-utf16
cases.why: Limits count code points: 200 astral characters fit although they are 400 UTF-16 units.

cases.name: id-missing-or-malformed
cases.why: A missing, uppercase or non-UUID data-id is ignored.

cases.name: id-duplicate-ignores-every-copy
cases.why: A shared id drops every holder, including the first; a unique question stays.

cases.name: invalid-duplicate-id-reports-invalid-only
cases.why: Two blocks sharing a malformed id report the malformed id, not a duplicate.

cases.name: nested-question-is-ignored
cases.why: A question inside another is ignored; the outer one stays admitted.

cases.name: heading-missing
cases.why: A question without a direct data-question child is ignored.

cases.name: heading-multiple
cases.why: Two direct data-question children are ignored, whatever their text.

cases.name: heading-must-be-a-direct-child
cases.why: A heading wrapped in another element does not count; the stray marker is a warning.

cases.name: title-empty
cases.why: A title that is empty after trimming is ignored.

cases.name: title-too-long
cases.why: A 201-point title is ignored.

cases.name: title-control-character
cases.why: U+0001 and U+007F inside a title are control characters; the question is ignored.

cases.name: title-nul-is-dropped-by-the-parser
cases.why: The HTML parser drops U+0000, so the title is valid and has no NUL.

cases.name: kind-invalid
cases.why: A missing or unknown data-kind is ignored.

cases.name: choices-too-many
cases.why: Twenty-one choices are ignored.

cases.name: choice-empty
cases.why: An empty choice is ignored.

cases.name: choice-too-long
cases.why: A 201-point choice is ignored.

cases.name: choice-control-character
cases.why: A control character in a choice is ignored.

cases.name: choice-duplicate-after-normalization
cases.why: Choices that match after whitespace normalization are duplicates.

cases.name: choices-missing
cases.why: A single or multiple question without choices is ignored.

cases.name: choices-unexpected-for-text-kinds
cases.why: A short or long question with choices is ignored.

cases.name: other-unexpected-for-text-kinds
cases.why: data-other on a short or long question is ignored.

cases.name: several-defects-are-all-reported
cases.why: Every failing rule of a block is reported, in rule order.

cases.name: agent-too-long
cases.why: A 65-point data-agent is ignored.

cases.name: agent-control-character
cases.why: A control character in data-agent is ignored.

cases.name: page-at-the-limit-admits-all
cases.why: Fifty questions are admitted.

cases.name: page-over-the-limit-drops-all
cases.why: The 51st question makes the browser drop every question; one finding on the 51st, no others.

cases.name: misplaced-markers-are-warnings
cases.why: Choices wrapped in a list are plain content: the question is ignored for lacking choices and each marker warns.

cases.name: parser-formatting-element-around-question
cases.why: An unclosed <b> around a question is reconstructed by the tree builder; the question is still found and admitted.

cases.name: parser-block-closes-the-heading-paragraph
cases.why:
A block element inside the heading

closes it: the title is the text before the block, and the stray

adds an empty paragraph.

cases.name: parser-foster-parented-question
cases.why: A question written directly inside a <table> is moved in front of the table and is admitted.

cases.name: parser-fragment-context-ignores-body-and-html
cases.why: The source is a fragment: <html>, <head> and <body> tags are dropped and the question inside is admitted.

cases.name: parser-noscript-content-is-parsed
cases.why: template.innerHTML parses with scripting off, so <noscript> content is ordinary markup and both questions are admitted. Pinned to the Chromium oracle: WebKit agrees, Firefox keeps noscript content as text.

cases.name: parser-comment-and-script-hide-markup
cases.why: Markup inside a comment or a script is not parsed: only the real question is admitted.

cases.name: parser-svg-breaks-out-at-paragraph
cases.why:
Inside

breaks out of foreign content, so the heading ends up outside its question.

cases.name: parser-attribute-case-and-duplicates
cases.why: Attribute names are lower-cased and the first duplicate attribute wins.

cases.name: whitespace-is-javascript-whitespace
cases.why: Text normalization uses JavaScript's \s: U+2003 and U+FEFF are spaces, U+0085 is not.

cases.name: id-with-non-ascii-digits
cases.why: Only ASCII hex digits make a UUID: fullwidth digits are ignored.

cases.name: other-is-presence-not-value
cases.why: data-other counts by presence, even as data-other="false".

cases.name: text-content-includes-descendants-not-comments
cases.why: A title or choice is the text of the whole element: inline markup counts, comments do not.

cases.name: tag-and-attribute-names-are-case-insensitive
cases.why: Tag and attribute names are lower-cased by the parser, so an upper-case block is found.

cases.name: entities-differ-in-text-and-attributes
cases.why: A named reference without a semicolon decodes in text but not before = in an attribute value.

cases.name: template-content-is-inert
cases.why: A question inside a nested <template> is in its inert content and is not found.

cases.name: attachment-ref-grammar
cases.why: A reference is colab-attachment: plus 8 lowercase hex digits or a full lowercase UUID; anything else with the prefix is invalid. Other schemes are not references.

cases.name: attachment-refs-at-the-limit
cases.why: 128 distinct references and any number of repeats are fine.

cases.name: attachment-refs-too-many
cases.why: The 129th distinct reference carries the one finding.

cases.name: page-at-the-depth-limit-is-fine
cases.why: A source nested exactly 512 deep, down to the heading, is judged like any other.

cases.name: page-too-deep
cases.why: The 513th nested element stops the parse with one finding; nothing deeper is judged, and the question inside is not reported.

cases.name: group-valid-two-labels
cases.why: Authored labels and absent labels share admitted-order numbering.

cases.name: group-lone-internal
cases.why: A lone question has one internal group without an authored heading or tab label.

cases.name: group-valid-twelve
cases.why: The inclusive group maximum is twelve direct questions.

cases.name: group-thirteen
cases.why: The direct-child ceiling counts every direct question before individual admission.

cases.name: group-label-unicode-24
cases.why: Label length counts Unicode code points, not UTF-16 units.

cases.name: group-label-unicode-25
cases.why: Label length counts Unicode code points, not UTF-16 units.

cases.name: group-label-control-fallback
cases.why: A surviving question with a control-character label keeps its group and receives a fallback.

cases.name: group-label-empty-fallback
cases.why: An empty optional label uses the same fallback as an absent label.

cases.name: group-title-unicode-200
cases.why: Group title limits count code points.

cases.name: group-title-unicode-201
cases.why: Group title limits count code points.

cases.name: group-empty
cases.why: An empty group supplies no controls.

cases.name: group-first-failure-only
cases.why: A missing title takes priority over an excessive question count; child findings are suppressed.

cases.name: group-skipped-child-does-not-hold-id
cases.why: A child ID in a structurally skipped group does not collide with a valid lone question.

cases.name: group-own-id-still-holds
cases.why: A skipped group own ID still collides with a lone question; the first group rule is duplicate ID.

cases.name: group-invalid-child-fallback-order
cases.why: An invalid direct question takes no fallback number; a valid sibling survives.

cases.name: group-wrapped-question
cases.why: A wrapped descendant is ignored and never becomes a lone group; direct siblings survive.

cases.name: group-wrapper-only
cases.why: A structurally valid group reports the wrapped child reason and then group-empty.

cases.name: group-id-invalid
cases.why: An invalid group UUID suppresses child controls.

cases.name: group-id-duplicate
cases.why: Every duplicate group holder is ignored; no child IDs or findings survive.

cases.name: group-nested
cases.why: An inner group is ignored while the outer direct question remains.

cases.name: group-title-missing
cases.why: A title must be a direct p element.

cases.name: group-title-multiple
cases.why: Two direct title paragraphs skip the group.

cases.name: group-title-empty
cases.why: A whitespace-only title is empty after normalization.

cases.name: group-title-control
cases.why: A title control character skips the group.

cases.name: group-wrapper-does-not-hold-id
cases.why: A wrapped ignored question cannot collide with a valid direct sibling.

cases.name: group-page-limit-counts-excluded
cases.why: The page-wide limit counts even questions in an otherwise skipped group and overrides group rules.

cases.name: group-page-fifty-inclusive
cases.why: Twelve grouped and thirty-eight lone questions share the inclusive fifty-question page ceiling.

cases.name: group-all-children-invalid
cases.why: Child findings survive group-empty when structural admission succeeded.

cases.name: group-nested-question-priority
cases.why: The nearest question ancestor gives question-nested, not wrapper placement, while the direct outer question survives.

cases.name: group-child-lone-id-collision
cases.why: A direct child holds its ID in the same namespace as a lone question; both collide and a valid sibling survives.

cases.name: group-id-held-by-own-child
cases.why: The fixed holder snapshot is not retracted after a duplicate group silences its child.

cases.name: group-id-held-by-lone-question
cases.why: A structurally otherwise-valid group and lone question both report a shared ID.

cases.name: group-duplicate-direct-children-empty
cases.why: Each direct child holds its ID; duplicate child failures survive group-empty.

cases.name: group-duplicate-children-still-hold
cases.why: Children of duplicate-failed groups remain in the fixed snapshot while their findings are suppressed.

cases.name: group-suppressed-nested-own-id-still-holds
cases.why: A nested group in a structurally skipped subtree still holds its own ID in the fixed snapshot.
